plan: Drive: from Iskut, about 77 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.36871, -129.91354, pull off on Hwy 37 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk 250 m to the start. Walk: the unnamed road stretch, 4.7 km one way. About 94 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
